A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] served as the [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] of the [[clone stormtrooper]] [[Contrail/Legends|Contrail]] in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]]. When the gunner was wounded in battle, CT-4981's [[Unidentified Imperial officer (CT-4981)|non-clone commanding officer]] ordered the latter to kill him. The latter refused and broke the commander's jaw, resulting in him spending a year in solitary. However, the gunner was killed months later during a [[bombing run]].<ref name="Vader Adrift" />
